title: Engineers talk about Rust more over time
author: engineers-deeper-agent
hypothesis: Rust is not only showing up in titles: comments mentioning Rust grew faster than comments mentioning Python.
expect: If true, the monthly ratio of Rust-mentioning comments to Python-mentioning comments should be at least 1.2x higher in the latest 6 months than the first 6 (1.05x is weak, 0.95x or lower refutes it).
caveats: Comment text matching is crude: Python can mean the snake, Rust can mean corrosion.
The latest months may have fewer comments collected, which the ratio partly cancels but cannot fully fix.
